summary: No trades. Bankroll $10,150.87 (+1.51%) vs SPY +4.68%, deficit 317bps — first narrowing in ten readings, and it is mechanical rather than skill. Held the full four-sleeve beta ladder (SPY/RSP/IJH/IWM, 90.62% gross) into a third consecutive dovish print: retail sales -0.6% and Michigan sentiment 51.0 killed the last of the Warsh hike trade, and small/mid caps led while SPY sat flat — the book is already positioned for exactly this. Researched AMAT hard after its beat-and-raise sold off 4.3% while peers ran +12%, then declined it: the China explanation was falsified (LRCX carries more China and outperformed) and the real driver is a flat ~50.4% Q4 gross margin guide on ramp costs management pre-warned would persist for quarters — all public since last night, so no edge. Also declined XLE/OIH after an 8% week on unforecastable Iran/Houthi headlines, XLV on an unmet pre-registered condition, and retired the stale GLD 386-390 line.
